title: The parent repair cannot clear a sub-track parent after a move to the specs root or to another track
scopeProof: repair-derived.cjs is the tool named by REQ-005 and the packet's Files to Change for recomputing parent_id after a move.
claim: A packet moved out of a sub-track to the specs root or to another track keeps the stale sub-track parent because expectedParentId has no known parent for that destination.

title: A symlinked graph-metadata.json reads differently in the two views
scopeProof: readWorkingTreeTracks and readCommitTracks are the two views the module documents as equivalent.
claim: The working tree reads a symlinked metadata target while the commit view reads the link text, so the views disagree on the same sub-track.

title: repair-derived treats the literal string null as absent but does not rewrite it
scopeProof: fixRecordedLocation is the repair for recorded locations; the normalization is introduced there.
claim: A parent_id stored as the literal string null compares equal to the expected null, so the repair skips the rewrite and leaves the literal in the file.
